packageRules.description: Hold Spring Boot below 4.2 until Spring Framework 7.1.1 fixes the deadlock between the bean-type cache and the singleton lock (spring-projects/spring-framework#37516). Remove this rule once 7.1.1 is released.
Minor and patch updates are merged by Renovate once CI is green. Note: this only takes effect where the branch protection of develop lets Renovate merge, otherwise the PR just waits for a review.
Major updates always need a human.

Node.js is pinned in the CI workflow and in gradle.properties (used by the production image build); they must move together, otherwise CI tests on a different Node than the one that builds the production webapp.
pnpm is pinned in package.json, in the CI workflow and in gradle.properties.
Keep the test runner packages together.

customManagers.description: Node.js version used by the Gradle node plugin to build the webapp
pnpm version used by the Gradle node plugin to build the webapp
